title: Lemma 10.8: unramified transformations preserve pushout squares
statement_scope: Let θ:T′→T be an unramified transformation of pregeometries. Let Z be an ∞-topos, and suppose given a pushout square σ in Str^loc_T(Z) whose horizontal maps are effective epimorphisms. Let Θ:Str^loc_T(Z)→Str^loc_T′(Z) be given by composition with θ. Then Θ(σ) is a pushout square in Str^loc_T′(Z). The whole lemma is retained, including all hypotheses on θ, Z, the pushout square and the effective epimorphisms; no subpart is separated.
